description: Slime-Meteor (SlimefunHelper) - A Meteor Client addon providing 100+ utility modules for Slimefun servers on Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric). Features SM category tabs in the ClickGui, Chinese localization toggle, and GUI window layout persistence. Derivative work by XC_Xin_Cheng.

mods.name: slime_meteor
mods.description: A utility mode for better gaming

releases.notes:
## What's New

- **SM ClickGui bridge**: all modules appear in Meteor's ClickGui under `SM <original group>` categories (all addons supported), with toggle state synced both ways
- **Localization toggle** (`汉化SM` module in the Slime-Meteor category): module names are localized from bundled language data, with built-in supplements, I18nXC integration, and English fallback
- **Title-screen credits**: `Slime-Meteor by m1919810 & GLMv5.3F & XC_Xin_Cheng`
- **GUI window layout persistence**: dragged category windows are remembered across sessions (missing in the 1.21.11 GUI rewrite); works for every addon's categories
- **Removed** the Scanner button from the multiplayer screen

## Fixes

- Fixed double-initialization crash (`Plugin bootstrap has already started`)
- Fixed NPE in the debug-HUD mixin before Meteor initializes
- Fixed crash from registering a test item after the registry freezes

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**
- [Meteor Client](https://maven.meteordev.org/) (1.21.11 build) and Fabric API
- Drop the jar into your `mods` folder
